book: Othonis Casmanni, Angelographia seu Commentationum disceptationumque physicarum (Frankfurt, Palthenius, 1597): one work in two parts (Pars prima and Pars altera) after a prodromus, dedicatory letters and indexes; each part is divided into numbered chapters (Caput), with questions (Quaestio) inside the chapters.
